## Kawaii Font Pack

![Kawaii font showcase](https://i.postimg.cc/8cG1M7fW/kawaii-fonts-darkmode-phone-sheet-background-fixed.png)

Brings a collection of cute, playful font replacements into League of Legends.

Choose your favorite font version:

- Mochiy Pop One
- Hachi Maru Pop
- DynaPuff
- Cherry Bomb One

Click on **Versions** to download your favorite font:

![Version selection](https://i.postimg.cc/GhCKqnSy/version.png)

For matching Sakura Gold Text icons that replace gold with Sakura flowers, use:

[**Sakura Gold Text**](https://www.divineskins.gg/tor.lol/sakura-gold-text)

Got an idea for another Mod or UI specific Wish? Send recommendations! I’m always looking for fun new ones to make.

## Support
